name: System stats
author: Rohit Kaushal
description: CPU, GPU, NPU, memory and storage meters with a detail panel

barWidget.description: CPU, GPU, NPU, memory and storage meters with a detail panel

schema.label: Storage mount
schema.description: Mount point reported in the storage section, e.g. / or /home.

schema.label: Warn threshold (%)
schema.description: Load at which meters start tinting away from the base foreground.

schema.label: Critical threshold (%)
schema.description: Load at which meters reach the theme's urgent colour.

schema.label: GPU alert (%)
schema.description: Show a mark over the bar meters while GPU work (busy % x clock / max clock) is above this percentage.

schema.label: NPU alert (%)
schema.description: Show a mark over the bar meters while NPU load is above this percentage. 0 marks any NPU activity.
